My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the package, try these steps:
Check around your home first (front door, porch, package lockers, side entrances, etc.).
Verify the delivery address used at checkout to make sure it’s correct.
Contact the shipping carrier listed on your tracking and file a missing package claim using your tracking number.
Sometimes “delivered” can also mean the package reached a local carrier hub or was handed to the carrier, not that it has arrived at your home yet.
If the item still can’t be located, keep your tracking details and any delivery photos or documentation for reference when following up with the carrier.
